notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard malformed-input handling. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador, DataElement, and standard-library APIs; the adapter supplies the provider package, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and invalid FOM corpus. It verifies missing and malformed FOM creation failures, standard invalid-FOM diagnostics, truncated encoded-value rejection, and disconnect cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.
